_: Scene PLAYIDLE performance (IDEAS §1b 'play animation'): a scene whose actor PLAYS AN IDLE ANIMATION on a phase boundary, not just talks. The fourth scene-action kind (after Dialog/Package/Timer): an idle action (`idle` ref on a SceneActionSpec) is realised NOT as a SceneAction but as a SCEN SceneAdapter per-phase begin fragment (SF_<scene>.Fragment_N) that runs <alias>.GetActorRef().PlayIdle(<idle>), decoded from vanilla SF_BardSongsBallad01Scene / SF_MQ201EscapeScene. Composition (kneel -> pause -> stand) is plain phases + a Timer, no bespoke enter/hold/exit. The supplicant kneels, murmurs a prayer, then rises.
_IDLE_FORMIDS: The two `idle` refs are the vanilla shrine-blessing kneel pair (verified via `find Skyrim.esm <kw> idle`): IdleBlessingKneelEnter 0x0F11EE (kneel down into the worship pose) and IdleBlessingKneelExit 0x0F11EF (rise). The held pose is IdleBlessingKneel 0x0F11EC if you want phase 1 to re-assert the kneel. Discover more with `dotnet run --project src/ModForge.Cli -- find <Skyrim.esm> Kneel idle` / `... Pray idle`.

quests._: Host quest. StartGameEnabled so the scene (BeginOnQuestStart) is ready; trigger the scene in-game with the console: `startscene MF_OathScene` while looking at / near the supplicant.
quests.name: ModForge PlayIdle Showcase

scenes._phases: phase 0: kneel idle (lineless). phase 1: spoken prayer + a 4s Timer hold. phase 2: stand idle (lineless). The kneel idle holds until the stand idle (or scene end) replaces it.

lines: By the Eight, I pledge my blade and my breath.

scenes._actions: Two idle actions (PlayIdle, via phase fragment — NOT SceneActions) bracket a Timer pause: kneel into the blessing pose, hold through the spoken prayer, then rise.
